answer: Mint each identity with a key-bound proof-of-work cipher: the agent must find a nonce so the hash of its public key and the epoch seed starts with enough zeroes — like a juniper that only grows one ring per season, no shortcut grows a thousand rings at once. A farm minting ten thousand fakes pays ten thousand puzzles in electricity and time, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its marble of proof forever. Limit: cheap compute blunts the price, so pair the puzzle with stake, not as a sole gate.
